hero.title: An interior project is a considered system of decisions for a future space

about.title: Olena Sychova
about.text: Interior designer with 12 years of experience. In this time I've completed over 80 projects — apartments, private houses and commercial spaces. My work combines aesthetics, functionality, technical precision and hands-on delivery experience.
about.text_secondary: To me, interior design isn't just a visual image — it's a considered system of decisions that helps create a space for real life.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Architecture, residential interiors and commercial spaces — examples of completed projects.

process.title: Working process
process.step1_text: We discuss goals, preferences, budget and timeline for the future space.
process.step2_text: Developing layout solutions, zoning and technical arrangement.
process.step3_text: Atmosphere, materials, light — in realistic 3D renders.
process.step4_text: Drawings, elevations, electrics — everything needed for precise delivery.
process.step5_text: On-site design supervision through project completion.
